```
(Currently Amended) Claim 1: An apparatus for profiling a beam of a light emitting semiconductor device, comprising: a light emitting semiconductor device comprising an active region formed on a substrate and configured to generate light when a suitable electrical current is applied to contacts on an upper surface of the device, and a light emitting surface defined by a surface of the substrate opposite the contacts; and a transmission medium comprising a first surface in contact with at least part of the light emitting surface of the semiconductor device and a diffusion surface, opposite the first surface, configured to diffuse light emitted from the semiconductor device and transmitted through the transmission medium, wherein the first surface of the transmission medium is configured to form a substantially optical coupling with the light emitting surface of the light emitting semiconductor device.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: An apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the transmission medium has a refractive index that is in the range of 1.4 to 1.7, configured such that there is substantially no reflection at the interface between the transmission medium and the substrate of the light emitting semiconductor device.

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: An apparatus according to any preceding claim, further comprising a pair of probes configured to apply an electrical current to the contacts of the light emitting semiconductor device, wherein the probes are positioned in proximity to the contacts to ensure effective application of said electrical current.

(Currently Amended) Claim 23: An apparatus according to any preceding claim, comprising a plurality of light emitting semiconductor devices grown on a silicon wafer, wherein the first surface of the transmission medium is configured to be in contact with the light emitting surfaces of at least two of the plurality of light emitting semiconductor devices.

(Currently Amended) Claim 25: A method for profiling a beam of a light emitting semiconductor device, the method comprising: applying an electrical current to contacts on an upper surface of a light emitting semiconductor device, the light emitting semiconductor device comprising an active region formed on a substrate and a light emitting surface defined by a surface of the substrate opposite the contacts; transmitting light emitted from the light emitting semiconductor device through a transmission medium comprising a first surface in contact with at least part of the light emitting surface of the light emitting semiconductor device and a diffusion surface, opposite the first surface, configured to diffuse light emitted from the light emitting semiconductor device and transmitted through the transmission medium; and determining the intensity of light power that would be emitted into air from the light emitting semiconductor device at one or more angles with respect to a normal based on the diffusion profile of said transmitted light.

(Currently Amended) Claim 26: A method for profiling a beam of a light emitting semiconductor device, the method comprising: processing, by a beam profiler, an image to determine the intensity of light power that would be emitted into air from the light emitting semiconductor device at one or more angles with respect to a normal, the image comprising light emitted from a light emitting semiconductor device comprising an active region formed on a substrate and configured to generate light when a suitable electrical current is applied to contacts on an upper surface of the device, and a light emitting surface defined by a surface of the substrate opposite the contacts, the light further being transmitted through a transmission medium comprising a first surface in contact with at least part of the light emitting surface of the light emitting semiconductor device and a diffusion surface, opposite the first surface, and configured to diffuse light emitted from the light emitting semiconductor device and transmitted through the transmission medium, and processing the intensity being performed while the light is taken by an optical detector positioned to capture the diffused light profile at multiple angles.

(Currently Amended) Claim 28: A non-transitory computer readable medium comprising computer readable code configured, when read by a computer, to carry out the method according to claim 26 or 27, wherein the code further accommodates processing of the intensity of the light based on variations in the captured image profile.

(Currently Amended) Claim 29: A computer program comprising computer readable code configured, when read by a computer, to carry out the method according to claim 26 or 27, wherein the program includes instructions for interpreting signals received from the optical detector to calculate the light profile emitted from the light emitting semiconductor device.
```
